archetypes.name: timing-contract
archetypes.rationale: Absolute-time chart placement spans shell and progress paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the timing-ledger parsing and clamping contract across final reports and progress reports. Check that round windows are unfiltered by skill, vendor rows are selected by overlap, and rows passed to the renderer use absolute clamped bounds. Pay special attention to off-by-one placement and zero/short-duration rows Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: best-effort-shell
archetypes.rationale: Final report generation must not fail when chart rendering fails.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell integration under set -euo pipefail. Confirm renderer failures, missing python3, malformed timing rows, and empty row sets degrade as intended without false no-task notes when overlapping rows existed. Check Bash 3.2 compatibility Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
